bass.tags: Funk rock. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, percussive riff using 16th-note scratches and double-stops. An electric bass guitar performs a slap-and-pop technique, locking with the kick drum on the downbeat and syncopating on the off-beats. The drum kit features a tight, dry snare sound and a consistent hi-hat pattern with occasional open accents. A Hammond organ provides sustained chords with a slow rotary speaker effect. The tempo is 105 BPM in the key of E minor. The arrangement maintains a steady groove with minimal melodic variation, focusing on rhythmic interplay between the bass and guitar.
